quiet.$comment: Reflections hidden by who left them or what they name, for a visitor whose reflections kept naming private people after earlier ones were hidden. Reflect answers as it always does, without an error that would invite a new name, and says only that the reflection is held. Each entry is the SHA-256 of a lower-case form, so this public file repeats none of it: names is a whole name, its words joined by single spaces; words is any one word of a name or a text. Make an entry with: printf '%s' 'word' | shasum -a 256. Added 2026-10-25.
